refined_brief: Connect finite-element plastic-hinge images, eight K-means labels and logistic regression to detected deformation mechanisms; add the reported test-accuracy comparison without presenting cluster labels as independent ground truth.
source_evidence: Accepted manuscript figures 2–4 and 7, Table 1 (p. 14), and Table 2 (p. 15). Replotted test accuracies for learning rates 0.00001, 0.0001 and 0.001 are 46.29%, 79.83% and 88.08%; reported-results.csv preserves the values. These are three model-setting results, not error bars or independent replications. The plot uses a common 0–100% scale.
limitations: KNet1 published study only. Four of six named mechanisms were identified. Test accuracy is against cluster-derived labels; the paper explicitly notes the absence of independent ground truth. No new training or KNet2 accuracy result is implied.
